description: Polyphonic plucked-string voice built on the Karplus-Strong algorithm, each pluck ringing on and fading out by itself

params.text: Picks the burst the string is filled with at the pluck: random, square, saw, noisysaw, sin or sinchirp
Changes the filter name shown on the display and nothing else; one string filter is built into the module and every pluck uses it
Sets the pitch of a pluck in semitones, 54 either side of C4 at 261.63Hz
Sets how fast a pluck dies away, a long ring at 0.1 and a short one at 4
Sets the weight of the one-sample averaging filter that damps the string, 0 to 1, damping hardest in the middle of that range
Nothing in the module reads this control; only the A weight is fed to the one string filter that is built
Plucks a string on the first channel each time it is pressed
Fades every sounding string out quickly

inputs.text: A rising edge plucks a string on that channel, which takes the pitch and the other settings as they stand at that moment
Picks the starting burst in place of the knob, 0V to 10V running through the six of them
Changes the filter name shown on the display and nothing else; one string filter is built into the module and every pluck uses it
Raises the pitch of a pluck by an octave per volt
Shortens the ring, adding one to the decay setting per volt
Shifts the filter weight by a tenth per volt
Nothing in the module reads this control; only the A weight is fed to the one string filter that is built

outputs.text: The sounding strings, -2V to 2V, on one polyphonic channel per triggered channel

notes: thirty-two voices are shared out over the channels, so two plucks close together on one channel both ring.
nothing sounds until a string is plucked, by the trigger button or by a rising edge at the trig input.
